_why: A scaffold's defects are mass-produced: every gate built from it inherits them, wearing tests that look like coverage. The first four mutations are the three emitted invariants plus the emitted spec's target tree -- the bug this scaffold actually shipped on its first run. The rest defend the refusals that stop it writing something unusable. Two anchors need surrounding context because the spec BUILDER embeds the same strings it emits.

mutations.name: emit-a-cannot-judge-that-carries-a-count
mutations._mechanism: Invariant 1, at scale: every gate scaffolded from then on ships a zero indistinguishable from 'nothing was measured'. #39's shape, mass-produced.
mutations.find:
if "{count_name}" not in result:
        # Cannot-judge: no count, deliberately.
mutations.replace:
if False:
        # Cannot-judge: no count, deliberately.

mutations.name: emit-a-gate-that-exits-non-zero-on-a-fail
mutations._mechanism: Invariant 2: callers branch on `$?` and read a successful measurement as a crash.
mutations.find:
# cannot-judge is an operational failure.
    return 2 if result["verdict"] == "{cannot}" else 0
mutations.replace:
# cannot-judge is an operational failure.
    return 0 if result["verdict"] == "{ok}" else 2

mutations.name: emit-only-a-one-way-docs-pin
mutations._mechanism: Invariant 3: a remedy row for a detail line the gate can no longer print drifts silently, and the reverse direction is the one nobody adds by hand.

mutations.name: point-the-emitted-spec-at-the-generators-own-tree
mutations._mechanism: The bug this scaffold shipped on its first run: every emitted spec targeted the real h-mad tree regardless of --skill-dir, so a scaffolded gate's mutations would mutate the WRONG repository.

mutations.name: allow-a-duplicate-verdict-token
mutations._mechanism: Two gates sharing one token means a caller reading the token cannot tell which one answered.

mutations.name: accept-any-slug
mutations._mechanism: A slug that is not an importable module name emits a file the generated test cannot import, so the suite errors at collection.

mutations.name: overwrite-without-force
mutations._mechanism: Silently destroying a gate someone is part-way through writing.

mutations.name: find-no-existing-tokens
mutations._mechanism: The accept direction of the collision guard: a detector that finds nothing makes every `token_taken` refusal unreachable while looking implemented.
